failure_reason: RETRY (2nd attempt) - re-verified the block far more thoroughly and it is genuine and precisely scoped, not a generic wall: tier (a) direct HTTP via curl_cffi across 7 browser-impersonation profiles (chrome124, chrome120, chrome110, chrome99, chrome101, chrome123, safari17_0, edge101) with a warmed session (homepage fetched first, then the category URL sent with Referer + full navigate headers on the same session) still returned Akamai's static 'Access Denied' page (title 'Access Denied - Bloomingdales', body 'YOU DON'T HAVE ACCESS TO THIS PAGE', server: AkamaiNetStorage) on every profile, every time. Tier (b) Playwright headless chromium with anti-detection init scripts (navigator.webdriver undefined, spoofed plugins/languages/chrome.runtime) plus realistic mouse movement and scroll on the homepage before navigating to the category page also got the identical Access Denied page, this time with an Akamai reference ID (e.g. '18.8e014017...') proving it is a real per-request edge deny, not a cached/static artifact. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome re-confirmed unavailable this session (list_connected_browsers returned [] again). Critically, this retry proved the block is deliberately scoped to /shop/* listing paths, not the whole site or the whole IP: (1) www.bloomingdales.com/robots.txt returns 200 every time; (2) the category XML sitemap at /dyn_img/sitemap/bcom_sitemap_cat_aa.xml.gz (AkamaiNetStorage-served, 340 URLs under /shop/home) returns 200; (3) non-shop real paths (/xapi/, /wcs/resources/store/, /content/help, /service/store-locator, /products/) all return the SITE'S OWN legitimate 404 page (origin-rendered, different content/size than the deny page), proving those requests pass through Akamai to the origin app; (4) every /shop/* and /shop/home/* URL, and even the bare '/' homepage, returns the 403 deny page on every method; (5) as a cross-check, the sibling Macy's-family site www.macys.com/ returned 200 from the identical curl_cffi session/profile/egress IP in the same run, proving this is a bloomingdales.com-specific Bot Manager policy targeting category/product listing pages, not an IP-reputation block affecting this network broadly. No API/JSON endpoint pattern equivalent to Macy's SR69 tier-(a) success (which reads raw SSR mega-menu HTML on macys.com, a host not behind this rule) exists for bloomingdales.com's /shop/* paths - they are uniformly Bot-Manager-gated. Given both a real curl_cffi TLS/HTTP2 handshake and a genuine headless-Chromium render are denied identically, this is confirmed as a deliberate, precisely-targeted Akamai Bot Manager rule on exactly the pages this task needs, not a bypassable fingerprinting gap. The category XML sitemap (not gated) remains the only reachable structured source and was used, together with a closer re-diff against 297 unique sitemap slugs, to build/refine the tree below; qty and live h1/canonical still cannot be confirmed for any node so every leaf remains qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag.
notes: RETRY WORKER (2nd pass on this company). Diagnostic cross-checks this retry added: robots.txt (200), the dyn_img sitemap (200, AkamaiNetStorage), and non-shop paths (/xapi/, /wcs/resources/store/, /content/help, /service/store-locator, /products/ - all return the site's own real 404, proving they reach the origin) are NOT behind the block, while every /shop/* and / URL is - proving this is a deliberate Bot-Manager rule scoped to listing pages, not a blanket site/IP block. Confirmed via a same-session, same-IP control fetch of www.macys.com/ (200 OK) that the egress network itself is not blacklisted - the block is bloomingdales.com-specific. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome re-confirmed unavailable (list_connected_browsers=[]). No bypass found; this is an honest, thoroughly-verified block, not a fixable fingerprinting gap. TREE: rebuilt from the site's own category XML sitemap (bcom_sitemap_cat_aa.xml.gz, dyn_img path, not behind the bot wall) - re-fetched fresh this pass, 340 URLs under /shop/home, 297 unique slugs after de-duplicating same-slug/different-id entries (keeping first-seen id). QTY: still could not be extracted for any row on this retry - every listing page returns Access Denied on every available tier; qty=null with flag='MANUAL REVIEW: qty unverifiable - all access tiers blocked' on every row, per hard rule 3 (null+flag over fabrication - no number was guessed or copied from a sibling/parent). GROUPING: parent labels (Bedding, Pillows & Throws, Bath, Rugs, Table Linens, Kitchen Textiles, Home Storage & Organization) remain inferred from rule-file section headings and site slug clustering, not confirmed via a live mega-menu (still unreachable) - flagged LOW/MEDIUM confidence accordingly. No View-All/Collection/search/product-detail URLs used - every link is a discrete named sitemap category URL. RESULT: this retry did not unblock qty/live confirmation (the block is real and precisely targeted, confirmed via 5 independent diagnostic angles above) but did improve tree completeness by +2 verified rows (1 textile, 1 storage) versus the prior partial attempt.
